shared_glob.about: Read(**/.env*) in the root .claude/settings.json (replicates the 11-10 result)

local_slash.about: Read(/.env) in the root .claude/settings.local.json: docs say / anchors at the primary working directory

sub_glob.about: Read(**/.env*) only in api/.claude/settings.json (the subfolder's own shared file)

flag_shared_glob.about: The root .claude/settings.json with Read(**/.env*), also passed as --settings <abs path>

flag_root_slash.about: --settings project/deny.json with Read(/.env): docs say / anchors at the file's folder

flag_dotclaude_slash.about: --settings project/.claude/deny.json with Read(/.env): / would mean project/.claude/.env

nogit_shared_glob.about: Read(**/.env*) in .claude/settings.json, project is not a git repo

nogit_local_glob.about: Read(**/.env*) in .claude/settings.local.json, project is not a git repo

inline_single_abs.about: --settings '<inline JSON>' with the project's full path after one slash, Read(/<project>/.env)

inline_double_abs.about: --settings '<inline JSON>' with Read(//<project>/.env), the documented absolute form
